description: Source code implementing a Random Tree Trainer for machine learning, including classes for tree nodes, training logic, and split construction.

classes.name: RandomTreeTrainer::Split
classes.description: Represents a potential split in the decision tree, including split index, score, and branch info.

classes.name: RandomTreeTrainer::Split::BranchInfo
classes.description: Holds training indices and target histogram for a branch of a split.

classes.name: InteriorNode
classes.description: Represents an internal node in the decision tree with children based on feature splits.

classes.name: LeafNode
classes.description: Represents a leaf node in the decision tree with a target distribution.

methods.name: RandomTreeTrainer::Train
methods.description: Initiates training of the random tree model asynchronously.

methods.name: RandomTreeTrainer::Build
methods.description: Recursively builds the decision tree based on training data and feature usage.

methods.name: RandomTreeTrainer::ConstructSplit
methods.description: Constructs a split candidate for a given feature index.

methods.name: RandomTreeTrainer::ComputeSplitScore_Nominal
methods.description: Calculates the score (nats remaining) for a nominal feature split.

methods.name: RandomTreeTrainer::ComputeSplitScore_Numeric
methods.description: Calculates the score (nats remaining) for a numeric feature split.

methods.name: RandomTreeTrainer::FindSplitPoint_Numeric
methods.description: Finds the optimal split point for a numeric feature.

methods.name: RandomTreeTrainer::FindSplitPoint_Nominal
methods.description: Selects a random nominal feature value for splitting.
